title: HAXcms theme registry entry (DRAFT)
description: One entry of coreConfig/themes.json (keyed by the theme element tag), and the shape of a plugin's registries/themes/*.json|yaml file. Derived from the 34 entries in haxcms-nodejs src/coreConfig/themes.json; no schema exists upstream yet, so this is a candidate to move into a shared schemas repo. Fields marked proposed are not read by core today.

element.description: Custom element tag; equals the registry key in every current entry.

path.description: Module path. Starts with @ for a registry theme (@haxtheweb/...); a site-relative URL is loaded verbatim (issue 3111).

category.description: Seen: Website, Course, Fun. Open list.

terrible.description: Deprecated. Marks intentionally bad novelty themes (for example geocities style) that can be used but are not meant to be; to be rolled into `hidden`. New plugin entries should use `hidden`.

supportedPalettes.description: Palette ids the theme supports; null means not constrained.

extends.description: PROPOSED: element tag of a parent theme. Lets a child theme fall back to its parent's registry entry and regions.

colorSchemes.description: Color schemes the theme supports through DDD tokens. Plugins that switch schemes (a dark mode toggle) act only on themes that list more than one. Omitted means light only.
